decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's resources through a combination of removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, along with disruptive creatures like Hullbreacher and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also aims to generate card advantage with cards like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Sylvan Library while utilizing powerful lands like Urza's Saga and Wasteland to maintain control of the game. The deck's strategy revolves around denying the opponent resources while gradually building up its own advantage to ultimately outvalue the opponent.

The main idea behind this deck is to control the game through a combination of powerful control spells and creature threats. By utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's plans, as well as efficient removal like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot. Meanwhile, cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Ice-Fang Coatl provide value and card advantage to grind out the game. The deck also utilizes powerful lands like Urza's Saga and Wasteland to further control the board and gain an advantage.

The deck revolves around utilizing the Aluren enchantment to cast creatures for free or at reduced cost, enabling a combo strategy that aims to generate value through creature interactions and card advantage. By deploying creatures such as Barrin, Tolarian Archmage, Cavern Harpy, and Baleful Strix while controlling the board with cards like Force of Will and Assassin's Trophy, the deck can outvalue and outpace opponents. The inclusion of versatile cards like Leovold, Emissary of Trest and Endurance further solidify its strategy of resource denial and incremental advantage.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and card advantage to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Urza's Bauble to constantly draw cards and generate value, the deck can easily outpace the opponent. With disruptive cards like Force of Will and Hullbreacher, the deck can also disrupt the opponent's strategy while continuing to build a board presence. Additionally, using Urza's Saga to fetch key artifacts like Mox Opal and Sai, Master Thopterist, the deck can quickly assemble a powerful combo to seal the game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize artifacts and card draw to quickly produce mana and generate card advantage, while also disrupting the opponent's gameplan. By assembling a combination of artifact mana sources and efficient card draw spells, the deck aims to establish a dominant board presence with powerful artifact creatures and tokens. Utilizing disruptive cards like Force of Will and Hullbreacher, the deck aims to control the game and overwhelm the opponent before they can effectively respond. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga to tutor for key artifacts and further strengthen its board position.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly generate mana using cards like Elvish Spirit Guide and Lotus Petal, and then use that mana to cast powerful spells like Goblin Charbelcher and Burning Wish. By combining mana acceleration with card draw and a high density of red mana sources, the deck aims to win quickly by either activating Charbelcher to deal lethal damage or casting Empty the Warrens to create a large army of goblin tokens. The inclusion of Land Grant and Taiga ensures the deck has consistent access to green mana for its key spells.

The main concept of this Aggro Canadian Threshold deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent using efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Stifle and Force of Will. The deck also aims to control the board through cards like Wasteland and Lightning Bolt, while maintaining card advantage with draw spells like Brainstorm and Sylvan Library. The deck looks to keep the opponent on the back foot, making it difficult for them to establish their own game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using Cloudpost lands and other support cards, allowing you to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures and utility spells like Ugin, the Spirit Dragon. The goal is to assemble a large amount of mana while controlling the board with cards like Pithing Needle and Expedition Map, enabling you to overwhelm your opponent with massive threats and game-changing abilities. The synergy between ramp and powerful threats makes this deck a formidable force in the Legacy format.

The main focus of this deck is to establish control over the opponent through the use of curses that hinder their ability to play effectively. By utilizing key cards such as Overwhelming Splendor, Curse of Death's Hold, and Cruel Reality, the deck aims to limit the opponent's resources and options. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Trinisphere and Thoughtseize further disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also features artifact manipulation with Helm of Obedience and Karn, the Great Creator to further solidify its control over the game.

This deck focuses on assembling the Dark Depths combo, which involves using cards like Crop Rotation and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 flying indestructible Marit Lage token. It includes cards like Knight of the Reliquary and Elvish Reclaimer to help search for the combo pieces, while also utilizing cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Mox Diamond for additional ramp and consistency. The deck also has disruption in the form of removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, as well as utility lands like Karakas and Bojuka Bog.

This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's game plan with disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth while using Aether Vial to cheat them into play quickly. With cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Recruiter of the Guard, you can search for powerful equipment like Sword of Fire and Ice and Batterskull to quickly close out the game. By utilizing powerful land disruption with cards like Wasteland and Rishadan Port, you can slow down your opponent's mana development while applying pressure with your aggressive creatures.

The main focus of this deck is to establish control over the opponent by using various curses and disruptive enchantments. By setting up a combination of curse cards such as Curse of Misfortunes and Cruel Reality, along with control cards like Ensnaring Bridge and Trinisphere, this deck aims to limit the opponent's options while setting up win conditions such as Helm of Obedience. Additionally, the deck utilizes disruptive creatures like Opposition Agent and powerful lands like The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale to further hinder the opponent's game plan.

The main strategy of this deck is to use Doomsday to stack the top of the library in a specific way, usually with Thassa's Oracle as the winning card, and then draw and play those cards in order to win the game in a single turn. The deck uses a variety of cantrips, acceleration spells, and disruption to help set up the combo and protect it from being disrupted by the opponent. The goal is to assemble the necessary pieces and execute the combo as quickly and efficiently as possible.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize powerful and disruptive cards like Blood Moon, Thorn of Amethyst, and Chalice of the Void to lock down the opponent's mana base while overwhelming them with aggressive creatures like Legion Warboss, Goblin Rabblemaster, and Fireflux Squad. The deck aims to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure to the opponent, using efficient removal spells like Dead / Gone and burn spells like Fury to clear the way for its creatures to attack for victory. The focus is on aggressive gameplay and disruption to secure a quick win.

The main concept of this deck is to control and disrupt the opponent's game plan through countering and stopping key plays with cards like Force of Will, Stifle, and Daze. By using cards like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent to apply pressure, while using Phyrexian Dreadnought to quickly close out the game, the deck aims to maintain control while setting up a fast win condition. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Dress Down and Brainstorm to provide card advantage and consistency in drawing into key pieces.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly play out powerful Merfolk creatures and use disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will to protect them. The combination of Lords of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident provide a significant power boost to all Merfolk creatures, while True-Name Nemesis is difficult to deal with for many opponent decks. The use of Aether Vial allows for creatures to be played at instant speed, and the land base includes utility lands like Karakas and Wasteland to disrupt opponents' strategies.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays by utilizing Ninjas to get in quick damage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key strategy revolves around getting creatures through using unblockable or evasive abilities, while also generating additional value through Yuriko's ability to reveal cards from the top of the library. The deck includes a mix of removal spells and countermagic to ensure the Ninjas can do their job effectively. Retrofitter Foundry also provides additional utility by creating tokens and potentially transforming Ornithopters into 4/4 creatures.

The main concept of this Legacy Aggro-Ninja deck is to utilize the evasive abilities of creatures like Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow and Changeling Outcast to deal damage quickly and consistently. The deck focuses on playing low-cost, high-impact creatures to apply pressure on the opponent while also having disruption in the form of counter spells like Force of Will and removal spells like Fatal Push and Murderous Cut. The inclusion of cards like Retrofitter Foundry and Brazen Borrower provide additional utility and versatility to help maintain board control and outmaneuver the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to use "Show and Tell" to cheat high-cost cards such as "Omniscience" into play. This allows the player to cast spells without paying their mana cost, leading to powerful combos and game-winning plays. The deck includes card draw and deck manipulation spells like "Brainstorm," "Ponder," and "Preordain" to find the key combo pieces. It also includes counterspells like "Force of Will" and "Pact of Negation" to protect the combo and disrupt opponent's strategies. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and win the game in a single explosive turn.

The deck aims to use Show and Tell to cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Omniscience onto the battlefield for free. It includes a variety of counter spells and card draw to protect the combo and find the necessary pieces. Cunning Wish provides additional flexibility to search for answers in the sideboard when needed. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, with lands like Ancient Tomb and Boseiju, Who Shelters All helping to support the combo strategy.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently get powerful creatures from the graveyard onto the battlefield to overwhelm the opponent. The deck aims to use cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead to bring back high-impact creatures like Griselbrand and Ashen Rider. It also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Unmask to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a combination of fast mana like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual, this deck can have explosive turns and win the game in just a few quick moves.

The main concept of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana through cards like Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Petal, while using cards like Dark Ritual and Cabal Ritual to further increase mana production. The deck aims to combo off by casting spells like Infernal Tutor and Ad Nauseam to find and cast Tendrils of Agony to deal lethal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Wishclaw Talisman and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own combo.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Murktide Regent while disrupting opponents with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also includes efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Expressive Iteration to maintain pressure on the opponent. The mana base consists of dual lands like Volcanic Island and fetch lands to ensure consistent casting of spells. The goal is to beat down opponents quickly while controlling the game with disruptive spells.

The deck focuses on using efficient spells and creatures to apply continuous pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and land destruction. It aims to quickly establish a board presence using cards like Delver of Secrets, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Murktide Regent, while also controlling the tempo of the game with cards like Daze and Force of Will. The deck's mana base is designed to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting its spells, making it a fast and adaptable aggro deck in the Legacy format.
